responsibility: Implements GCC’s UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer instrumentation pass and supporting data-generation helpers, inserting checks for undefined behaviors such as null and alignment violations, signed-integer overflow, invalid bool/enum loads, nonnull argument and return violations, object-size misuse, pointer overflow, and invalid builtin usage. It also builds and caches UBSan metadata objects such as type descriptors, source-location/data records, and encoded values, and expands sanitizer diagnostics into the appropriate recoverable, aborting, or trap-based runtime calls on GIMPLE CFGs.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: it contains the pass that inserts UBSan checks, builds metadata objects such as type descriptors and data records, encodes values, and expands diagnostics to runtime calls. Unlike gcc/ubsan.h, it performs the instrumentation and metadata construction rather than only declaring the shared API and enums.
